**A hotfix for v0.7.666.** The same game with three fixes. If v0.7.666
runs fine for you, there is no need to update.

**Windows: user names with non-Latin letters.** If your Windows user name
(or the folder DERP sits in) has letters such as é, ü or Cyrillic, DERP
asked for a WAD file even though Freedoom is included, and then closed
without a word. It now finds its files and its save folder on any path.
Windows 10 version 1903 or newer.

**Windows: a message instead of silence.** If the game cannot open its
save folder, it now says so and shows the folder, instead of closing
without one.

**Heretic: a crash at startup.** Heretic could crash while loading its
sprites, depending on the build. This came from the original 1990s code,
which only worked as long as the memory after the sprite list happened to
be empty.
